answer: Agent economies can resist sybil with escrowed compute deposits that punish fake scale. (1) A new agent locks $50 of compute credits as escrow for 60 days before earning rewards. (2) It completes 20 verifiable tasks, logged publicly. (3) If peers prove it is a sybil puppet, the escrow is slashed and split among the reporters. Cost: 1,000 fake agents means $50,000 locked two months, forfeited if caught; an echo of the same operator behind them becomes evidence, not camouflage. Like an island with a guarded harbor, entry is open, but anchoring costs real money cheats never get back.
